value.rationale: The problem classifies the exact invertibility boundary for the natural, continuously tunable model with two identical localized amplitude defects in a constant cyclic Gabor fiducial. Unlike a generic perturbation observation or isolated zero-amplitude census, it finds all rank-jump locations (including strictly positive amplitudes), shows arithmetic magnification 4d for noncoprime spacing, and covers every odd cyclic size and every real defect amplitude. The exact exceptional set directly informs deterministic full-rank window selection and makes the calibration-resonance phenomenon explicit.
